Live RTX 5090 smoke test passed 2026-07-12 (see qualifications/instantmesh-large_wsl2_rtx5090.json): watertight, 10 connected components, 26.9s. But fewer components than TripoSG's 17 does NOT mean better visual quality -- the rendered diagnostic is disorganized/apparently rotated and reads as far less coherent than TripoSG's candidate. Corpus-level quality qualification is still pending.

Required upgrading to torch==2.7.1+cu128 and installing a separate CUDA 12.8 toolkit mid-qualification: torch==2.1.0 and torch==2.6.0+cu124 both failed real kernel execution on this RTX 5090 ('no kernel image is available') despite torch.cuda.is_available()==True. Confirmed to be the same risk for TRELLIS.2's pinned torch==2.6.0+cu124 (see trellis2-4b entry below); same fix applied there.

Promoted to primary geometry candidate 2026-07-12 after TripoSG's topology quality proved insufficient; needs the WSL2 boundary (see environments/trellis2-wsl2-cu124.setup.md).

Live RTX 5090 smoke test passed 2026-07-12 (see qualifications/trellis2-4b_wsl2_rtx5090.json): 263.6s, real PBR GLB, by far the most visually coherent/recognizable result of the three geometry candidates qualified on this host (vs. TripoSG and InstantMesh on the same goblin fixture) -- correctly oriented, clean standing silhouette across all four rendered views.

Raw connected-component count (134,145) is dominated by an unwelded-vertex artifact of o_voxel's voxel-based surface extraction, not real fragmentation; trimesh.merge_vertices() drops it to 11,830. Even welded, that is still more technical fragments than TripoSG (17) or InstantMesh (10) despite the clearly best visual result -- component count alone is not a quality proxy for any of these three candidates.

Required two live compatibility patches in the Darkness adapter, both due to TRELLIS.2's own unpinned dependencies rather than any Darkness policy: a stub for trellis2.pipelines.rembg.BiRefNet (from_pretrained() unconditionally constructs it, which would otherwise download the gated non-commercial briaai/RMBG-2.0) and a shim for DinoV3FeatureExtractor.extract_features (transformers==5.13.1 nests DINOv3ViTModel's layers one level deeper than TRELLIS.2's code expects).

Required upgrading to torch==2.7.1+cu128 and installing a separate CUDA 12.8 toolkit: this environment's own setup.sh installs torch==2.6.0+cu124, which reports cuda_available=True but fails all real kernel execution on this RTX 5090 ('no kernel image is available'). Same root cause and fix as the InstantMesh entry above.
